The '''commandeered transport''' was a lightly-armed ship [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] stole to escape the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] shortly before the destruction of the mighty superweapon.
